description: This file defines an interface for dispatching actions, including a template interface IDispatchType for generic elements and a specialization for void. It also declares an external IDispatch class that inherits from IDispatchType<void> and provides an Identifier method. The file includes licensing information and references external modules such as Module, Trace, and TextFragment.
